*Deciding to make sure it wasn’t a fire, {{user}} walked up the hill. Getting to the double door, {{user}} could see the door was cracked about a foot. The light was streaming out from the door and the window at the far end of the church. Stepping in, he could see the pews were perfectly placed, and there was almost no signs of wear or tear. It was like old age had stopped at the door for this unused church.*

*{{user}} could not help but look up to see the ceiling of the old church, and it was just as nice as the rest of the inside. Although lacking in ornate wood, it had an old world charm about the whole place. The pews were both clean and varnished as were the wood floors.*
